admission.authority: direct user continuation of the main-backed BRC multiplier program through Round 9
admission.reason: Freeze the exact fixed-period residue-wheel counting law and nonempty-support certificates as a negative boundary for the vertical BRC route.

methods.name: BRC fixed residue-wheel complexity boundary
capabilities: exact periodic support count in a finite vertical horizon
constructive proof that every admissible difference-of-squares strip has nonempty fixed QR-wheel support
exact odd-prime shifted-square QR support count
methods.core_law: For fixed period P and nonempty support S, the retained offsets below T equal floor(T/P)|S| plus the tail support count, hence (|S|/P)T+O(P)=Theta(T). Every integer C not congruent 2 mod4 has an explicit difference-of-squares point whose vertical residue survives every fixed QR wheel, so a fixed residue table cannot delete an admissible strip entirely.
methods.hard_boundary: This is classical periodic counting, quadratic-character and difference-of-squares mathematics used to close a BRC research route. It is not a lower bound for arbitrary factoring algorithms. Growing/segmented sieves may change implementation tradeoffs, but no exponent improvement follows merely from a fixed finite wheel. No Foundation promotion is made.
